name: jira-ai-worker
description: JIRA → Claude Code MAX → PR automation worker

scripts.worker:reset-task: tsx -e "const k=process.argv[1];if(!k){console.error('Usage: npm run worker:reset-task -- MP-123');process.exit(1)}const f='.worker-state.json';const fs=await import('fs');if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.log('No state file');process.exit(0)}const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf-8'));if(s.processed[k]){delete s.processed[k];fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(s,null,2));console.log('Removed',k)}else{console.log(k,'not found in state')}"
scripts.worker:status: tsx -e "const f='.worker-state.json';const fs=await import('fs');if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.log('No state file');process.exit(0)}const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf-8'));const tasks=Object.values(s.processed);console.log('Tasks:',tasks.length);for(const t of tasks){console.log(' ',t.jiraKey,'-',t.status,t.prUrl||t.error?.slice(0,80)||'')}"
